title.en: Your Quick Sell icon: photo, price, publish — one screen
title.af: Jou Quick Sell-ikoon: foto, prys, plaas — een skerm
title.zu: Uphawu lwakho lwe-Quick Sell: isithombe, intengo, shicilela — isikrini esisodwa
title.xh: Uphawu lwakho lwe-Quick Sell: ifoto, ixabiso, papasha — isikrini esinye
title.nso: Seswantšhetšo sa gago sa Quick Sell: seswantšho, theko, phatlalatša — sekirini se tee

chapters.nso: Dira seswantšhetšo sa gago sa go akgofa

chapters.en: When your Free slots are full
chapters.af: As jou gratis plekke vol is
chapters.nso: Ge dikgoba tša gago tša mahala di tletše

en: Tick [[Make this my quick icon]]
At the end of a normal Quick sell, above Publish. Your answers are kept — never your price.
af: Merk [[Make this my quick icon]]
Aan die einde van 'n gewone Quick-verkoop, bo Publiseer. Jou antwoorde word bewaar — nooit jou prys nie.
zu: Maka [[Make this my quick icon]]
Ekugcineni kokuthengisa okujwayelekile ku-Quick, ngaphezu kokuthi Shicilela. Izimpendulo zakho ziyagcinwa — hhayi intengo yakho.
xh: Phawula [[Make this my quick icon]]
Ekupheleni kokuthengisa okuqhelekileyo kwi-Quick, ngaphezu kokuthi Papasha. Iimpendulo zakho ziyagcinwa — hayi ixabiso lakho.
nso: Swaya [[Make this my quick icon]]
Mafelelong a go rekiša mo go tlwaelegilego go Quick, godimo ga Phatlalatša. Dikarabo tša gago di a bolokwa — e sego theko ya gago.

en: Find it at the top of Quick
Your icon is ready: “Quick Sell · Cards”. It now sits at the top of Quick's first screen — tap it there.
af: Kry dit bo-aan Quick
Jou ikoon is gereed: “Quick Sell · Cards”. Dit sit nou bo-aan Quick se eerste skerm — tik dit daar.
zu: Luthole phezulu ku-Quick
Uphawu lwakho selulungile: “Quick Sell · Cards”. Manje lusesiqongweni sesikrini sokuqala se-Quick — luthephe lapho.
xh: Lufumane phezulu kwi-Quick
Uphawu lwakho lulungile: “Quick Sell · Cards”. Ngoku lukwincopho yesikrini sokuqala se-Quick — lucofe apho.
nso: Se hwetše godimo ga Quick
Seswantšhetšo sa gago se loketše: “Quick Sell · Cards”. Bjale se godimo ga sekirini sa mathomo sa Quick — se kgotle moo.

en: Optional: tap [[Also put it on my home screen]]
For the one you use every day. Then tap [[Add to home screen]]; on an iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
af: Opsioneel: tik [[Also put it on my home screen]]
Vir die een wat jy elke dag gebruik. Tik dan [[Add to home screen]]; op 'n iPhone: tik Deel, dan “Add to Home Screen”.
zu: Uma uthanda: thepha [[Also put it on my home screen]]
Kulolo olusebenzisa nsuku zonke. Bese uthepha [[Add to home screen]]; ku-iPhone: thepha u-Share, bese uthi “Add to Home Screen”.
xh: Ukuba uyathanda: cofa [[Also put it on my home screen]]
Kolo ulusebenzisa yonke imihla. Emva koko cofa [[Add to home screen]]; kwi-iPhone: cofa u-Share, emva koko “Add to Home Screen”.
nso: Ge o rata: kgotla [[Also put it on my home screen]]
Bakeng sa seo o se šomišago letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe. Ke moka kgotla [[Add to home screen]]; go iPhone: kgotla Share, ke moka “Add to Home Screen”.

en: Open your icon and add a photo
Tap [[Take photo]] or [[Use last photo]], then type the price and what exactly it is.
af: Maak jou ikoon oop en voeg 'n foto by
Tik [[Take photo]] of [[Use last photo]], tik dan die prys en wat presies dit is.
zu: Vula uphawu lwakho bese ufaka isithombe
Thepha [[Take photo]] noma [[Use last photo]], bese ubhala intengo nokuthi kuyini ngqo.
xh: Vula uphawu lwakho uze ufake ifoto
Cofa [[Take photo]] okanye [[Use last photo]], emva koko ubhale ixabiso nokuba yintoni kanye kanye.
nso: Bula seswantšhetšo sa gago o tsenye seswantšho
Kgotla [[Take photo]] goba [[Use last photo]], ke moka o ngwale theko le gore ke eng gabotse.

en: Tap [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Publish only appears once a real photo is attached — the example photo is never published.
af: Tik [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Publiseer verskyn eers wanneer 'n regte foto aangeheg is — die voorbeeldfoto word nooit geplaas nie.
zu: Thepha [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Ukushicilela kuvela kuphela uma kunesithombe sangempela — isithombe sesibonelo asishicilelwa neze.
xh: Cofa [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Ukupapasha kuvela kuphela xa kukho ifoto yokwenyani — ifoto yomzekelo ayipapashwa nanini na.
nso: Kgotla [[Publish now — I accept the Terms]]
Phatlalatša e tšwelela fela ge go na le seswantšho sa nnete — seswantšho sa mohlala ga se phatlalatšwe le ka mohla.

en: Your listing is live
Three screens: your icon, the fast screen, live. Tap [[Sell another]] for the next one.
af: Jou advertensie is aanlyn
Drie skerms: jou ikoon, die vinnige skerm, aanlyn. Tik [[Sell another]] vir die volgende een.
zu: Isikhangiso sakho sesiphila
Izikrini ezintathu: uphawu lwakho, isikrini esisheshayo, siphila. Thepha [[Sell another]] kokulandelayo.
xh: Isibhengezo sakho siphila ngoku
Izikrini ezithathu: uphawu lwakho, isikrini esikhawulezayo, siphila. Cofa [[Sell another]] kwesilandelayo.
nso: Papatšo ya gago e phela bjale
Dikirini tše tharo: seswantšhetšo sa gago, sekirini sa go akgofa, e phela. Kgotla [[Sell another]] go se se latelago.

en: Android: share a photo straight in
In your gallery tap Share, then “Quick Sell · Cards” — the photo arrives on the fast screen.
af: Android: deel 'n foto reguit in
Tik Deel in jou galery, dan “Quick Sell · Cards” — die foto kom op die vinnige skerm aan.
zu: Android: yabelana ngesithombe ngqo
Egalari yakho thepha u-Share, bese uthi “Quick Sell · Cards” — isithombe sifika esikrinini esisheshayo.
xh: Android: yabelana ngefoto ngqo
Kwigalari yakho cofa u-Share, emva koko “Quick Sell · Cards” — ifoto ifika kwisikrini esikhawulezayo.
nso: Android: abelana ka seswantšho thwii
Ka galaring ya gago kgotla Share, ke moka “Quick Sell · Cards” — seswantšho se fihla sekirining sa go akgofa.

en: Slots full? You choose
Your listing is kept. Tap [[Upgrade my plan]] or [[Choose a listing to rest]].
af: Plekke vol? Jy kies
Jou advertensie word bewaar. Tik [[Upgrade my plan]] of [[Choose a listing to rest]].
zu: Izikhala zigcwele? Wena uyakhetha
Isikhangiso sakho siyagcinwa. Thepha [[Upgrade my plan]] noma [[Choose a listing to rest]].
xh: Izithuba zizele? Wena uyakhetha
Isibhengezo sakho siyagcinwa. Cofa [[Upgrade my plan]] okanye [[Choose a listing to rest]].
nso: Dikgoba di tletše? O a kgetha
Papatšo ya gago e a bolokwa. Kgotla [[Upgrade my plan]] goba [[Choose a listing to rest]].

en: Tap [[Rest this one]], then publish
A resting listing is hidden from buyers. Nothing is deleted, and you can bring it back on Plans.
af: Tik [[Rest this one]], plaas dan
'n Rustende advertensie is vir kopers versteek. Niks word uitgevee nie, en jy kan dit op Plans terugbring.
zu: Thepha [[Rest this one]], bese ushicilela
Isikhangiso esiphumulayo sifihliwe kubathengi. Akukho okususwayo, futhi ungasibuyisa ku-Plans.
xh: Cofa [[Rest this one]], emva koko upapashe
Isibhengezo esiphumlayo sifihliwe kubathengi. Akukho nto icinywayo, kwaye ungasibuyisa kwi-Plans.
nso: Kgotla [[Rest this one]], ke moka o phatlalatše
Papatšo ye e khutšitšego e utilwe go bareki. Ga go selo seo se phumolwago, gomme o ka e bušetša go Plans.

en: In TrustSquare: My Space → My quick icons
Tap [[Switch off]] twice. You can also rename an icon there.
af: In TrustSquare: My Space → My quick icons
Tik twee keer [[Switch off]]. Jy kan 'n ikoon ook daar hernoem.
zu: Ku-TrustSquare: My Space → My quick icons
Thepha [[Switch off]] kabili. Ungaqamba kabusha uphawu lapho futhi.
xh: Kwi-TrustSquare: My Space → My quick icons
Cofa [[Switch off]] kabini. Unokuthiya kwakhona uphawu apho.
nso: Go TrustSquare: My Space → My quick icons
Kgotla [[Switch off]] gabedi. O ka fetola leina la seswantšhetšo moo gape.

en: An old icon opens normal Quick
It says “This quick icon was switched off.” and starts at step 1.
af: 'n Ou ikoon maak gewone Quick oop
Dit sê “This quick icon was switched off.” en begin by stap 1.
zu: Uphawu oludala luvula i-Quick ejwayelekile
Luthi “This quick icon was switched off.” bese luqala esinyathelweni 1.
xh: Uphawu oludala luvula i-Quick eqhelekileyo
Luthi “This quick icon was switched off.” luze luqale kwinyathelo 1.
nso: Seswantšhetšo sa kgale se bula Quick ye e tlwaelegilego
Se re “This quick icon was switched off.” gomme se thoma ka mogato wa 1.
